step1_analysis.description: A silicon retina pixel processing block consisting of two parts: a programmable current sink/integrator (Part 1) and a current-starved inverter driving two PMOS source followers (Part 2) for gradient extraction and buffering.

paper_reference.title: A 100 100 Pixel Silicon Retina for Gradient Extraction With Steering Filter Capabilities and Temporal Output Coding

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the pixel block.

sky130_expected.calculation: 13 transistors biased mostly in saturation. Assuming VDD=1.8V and bias voltages of 0.9V, current per branch is ~100-300uA. Total current ~1.5mA. Power = 1.8V * 1.5mA = 2.7mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V process. The original 0.5um process likely operated at 3.3V or 5V, but with smaller W/L ratios or subthreshold biasing to achieve 180uW. With standard 0.9V bias in SKY130, power will be higher unless biased in weak inversion.

delay.description: Propagation delay from the inverter input to the source follower output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay = C_load / gm. With parasitic capacitance only (~10fF) and gm ~ 1mA/V, intrinsic delay is < 1ns. The 60ns reported likely includes array routing capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Intrinsic delay of a single isolated pixel in SKY130 is much faster than the array-level 60ns reported in the paper.

gain_inv.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain of the current-starved inverter stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * (ro_p || ro_n). gm ~ 1mA/V, ro ~ 10kOhm. Gain ~ 10 V/V = 20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard common-source amplifier gain in 130nm technology with minimum length devices.

gain_sf.description: AC voltage gain of the PMOS source follower buffer.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm / (gm + gmb + 1/ro). Typically around 0.8 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Source followers always have a gain slightly less than 1 (0 dB) due to body effect and finite output resistance.

discharge_rate.description: Slew rate of the integration node (N5) when discharged by the programmable current sink.

sky130_expected.calculation: dV/dt = I / C. I ~ 10uA (with N8=0.5V), C ~ 25fF (MOSCAP). dV/dt = 10uA / 25fF = 0.4 V/ns = 4e8 V/s.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias voltage N8 and the size of the MOSCAP. Measured over a 1ns window after the pulse.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain of the inverter and source follower, transient delay, and the discharge rate of the integrator node.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Silicon Retina Pixel Block Testbench

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
XM1 N4 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N10 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND N3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N10 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 GND N3 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 LABEL_NET_6 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N5 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biases
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN8 N8 0 0.5
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8

* Input for Inverter (AC and Tran)
VIN VIN_NODE 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
R3 LABEL_NET_3 VIN_NODE 0 1m
R4 LABEL_NET_4 VIN_NODE 0 1m

* Input for MOSCAP Integrator
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 10 1k 1G
  let gain_inv_db = vdb(N3)
  let gain_sf_db = vdb(N2) - vdb(N3)
  meas ac low_freq_gain_inv find gain_inv_db at=1k
  meas ac low_freq_gain_sf find gain_sf_db at=1k
  meas ac ugf_inv when gain_inv_db = 0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 0.1n 100n
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(VIN_NODE) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(VIN_NODE) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 rise=1
  
  * Measure discharge rate of N5
  meas tran v_n5_t1 find v(N5) at=12n
  meas tran v_n5_t2 find v(N5) at=13n
  let discharge_rate = (v_n5_t1 - v_n5_t2) / 1n
  print discharge_rate
  
  quit
.endc
.end
